answer: Lost and found at NU Laguna is handled by the **Disciplinary Office**, which is **near the dugout**. Bring found items there, and go there to claim your things.

questions: how do i claim my item|how to claim|paano mag claim|what do i need to claim|what should i bring to claim|do i need my id to claim|kailangan ba ng id|what proof do i need|how do i get my item back|paano ko makukuha yung gamit ko|what are the steps to claim
answer:
To claim an item:
1. Go to the **Disciplinary Office near the dugout**.
2. Bring your **school ID** and your FindIt **reference code** if you have one.
3. Be ready to describe the item (color, brand, marks, what's inside) so the office can check it's yours.

questions: how long do you keep found items|what happens to unclaimed items|are unclaimed items donated|how many days are items kept|what do you do with unclaimed things

questions: how will i know if my item is found|will i get notified|do you send an email when there is a match|how do i check my report

questions: what information do i need to report|what details should i include|what should i give when reporting|how do i report a lost item|how do i report a found item
answer: Just tell me **what** the item is, **where** it was lost or found, and **when**. Details like color, brand, stickers or a case help a lot. For example: *\I lost my black Samsung phone at the library yesterday.\"*"

questions: what is findit|how does this chatbot work|how do i use this|what can you do|who made this chatbot|who built this|paano gamitin to
answer:
I'm **FindIt**, the lost and found assistant for NU Laguna. I use NLP (a TF-IDF + logistic regression classifier with a campus word list) to understand what you type. I can:
- record **lost** items and check them against found ones
- record **found** items so owners can get them back
- **search** items that were turned in
- answer questions about the process

I was built by NU Laguna students for our NLP elective.

questions: is my information private|who can see my report|do you share my data
answer: Only the office staff can see full reports. When someone searches, I only show basic info (item type, color, place and date) so no one can claim things that aren't theirs.
